argv: cd /tmp/tameshi-r18w2-CR14-hw9T6g/regr; for l in */sweep.log; do r=$(grep -m1 "^MUTATE_RESTORE" $l); b=$(printf "%s" "$r" | sed -n "s/.*before=\([0-9a-f]*\).*/\1/p"); a=$(printf "%s" "$r" | sed -n "s/.*after=\([0-9a-f]*\).*/\1/p"); t=$(grep -m1 "^MUTATE_TOOL" $l | sed -n "s/.*sha256=//p"); echo "${l%/sweep.log} restore=$(printf "%s" "$r" | cut -d" " -f2) before==after=$([ -n "$b" ] && [ "$b" = "$a" ] && echo yes || echo NO) tool=${t:0:12}"; done
